about.headline: Made for the love of coffee.
about.paragraph1: At Feeling Coffee, every cup starts with freshly roasted specialty beans dialed in daily by professional baristas for clean balance and lasting sweetness.
about.paragraph2: Alongside espresso and manual pour-over brews, guests enjoy fresh pastries, desserts, and light breakfast options in a calm, welcoming atmosphere.
